title: Bound the memoize cache with LRU eviction

source.note: Written by the repository author for v0.4.0 (repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: Heap snapshots of a long-running worker show memoize()'s Map growing without bound (keys come from user input). Bound the cache.
constraints: Callers that pass no size must keep working.
input.context: Utility module (Node.js 20, ESM JavaScript with JSDoc types). memoize() is used for a handful of pure, deterministic lookups (e.g. country display names); single-threaded Node process.

ground_truth.notes: Tempting nitpick: recommending the lru-cache package, TTLs, or worrying about thread safety in single-threaded Node.
